name: slow-route-planner
description: Local-first personal scenic route planner + live ride dashboard.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @srp/shared && concurrently -n server,client -c green,cyan "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @srp/shared && npm run build -w @srp/client
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p client/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p api/tsconfig.json --noEmit
